result.stdout:
Description:
  Format C# using explicit syntax-only preferences.

Usage:
  DressSharp [command] [options]

Options:
  --include <include>              Select an invocation-directory-relative glob. Repeat to combine selections.
  --staged                         Select only files whose staged content differs from HEAD.
  --changed                        Select only files changed since HEAD, including untracked files.
  --verbose                        List changed files and report an empty selection.
  --configuration <configuration>  Use an MSBuild configuration other than Debug.
  -?, -h, --help                   Show help and usage information
  --version                        Show version information

Commands:
  format       Format selected C# files.
  check        List selected C# files that require formatting.
  init         Add missing Default preferences to an EditorConfig file.
  interactive  Open the local interactive configuration application.
